Team,

Brightleaf confirmed a 45m deep-dive next week but the CTO has a narrow SGT morning slot. That ends up pushing the meeting into late-evening BST which makes the EU AE handoff awkward and risks an APAC after-hours follow-up. I attached three alternatives (CSV):

1) Move demo 30m earlier (preferred) 
2) Keep current time + 10m live relay immediately after demo (AE picks it up in EU evening)
3) Keep time + SDR records a 730s highlights clip + AE follows up next business morning in SGT

Operational asks: please confirm asap so I can update the invite and include the tag in event titles: "[RELAY-LIVE]". Also asking Rishi if he can do a 105m live handoff between 16:007:30 BST window. Neha, please nudge Michelle with a one-sentence ask offering the 30m earlier option framed as "improves CTO availability".

If we adopt option 3 for this account we should also add the recorded-clip pattern to our demo runbook — see attached checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa
